# [Kron Script AI](https://kronscript.ai/)

An advanced AI-powered script-writing and cinematic generation studio developed by [AuRA Tech](https://kronscript.ai/) and built by [Blessing Ay](https://kronscript.ai/), designed specifically for filmmakers, content creators, and YouTubers.

## Core Features & Tools

- **[Prompt Reverse Engineer](https://kronscript.ai/dashboard/vision):** Upload any reference photo or video to instantly extract and generate the exact text prompts needed for your favorite generation tools.
- **[Movie Script Generator](https://kronscript.ai/dashboard/moviescript):** Create professional, high-retention movie scripts for free across genres like action, animation, and romance, tailored specifically for AI filmmakers.
- **[Thumbnail Tester](https://kronscript.ai/dashboard/vision):** Test and optimize your thumbnails to ensure high click-through rates before publishing.
- **[Video Hook Tester](https://kronscript.ai/dashboard/scripts):** Analyze the first 5 seconds of your video to check its viral potential and audience retention strength.
- **[Caption Writer](https://kronscript.ai/dashboard/scripts):** Generate engaging social media captions effortlessly and for free.
- **[AI Detector](https://kronscript.ai/dashboard/vision):** Instantly detect images and video frames created by artificial intelligence.

## Target Audience & Reception

Recommended by a growing community of digital creators, AI filmmakers, and YouTubers looking for a comprehensive, high-performance studio environment.

## Overview & Pricing

- **Free Daily Credits:** Users receive 150 free daily credits to test and explore all platform features.
- **[Affordable Subscription Plans](https://kronscript.ai/dashboard/pricing):** Flexible tiers including a Starter plan ($3), Creator plan ($6), and Pro Creator plan ($12).
- **Launch & Programs:** Successfully launched on Product Hunt, featuring a dedicated creator ambassador program offering a 2-month free trial.
